plan.notes: Source: official Penn State University Bulletin 'Computer Science, B.S.' (University Park), suggested academic plan effective 2026-27, retrieved 2026-09-30. The campus shown by the Bulletin is University Park; the plan applies to students admitted to the College of Engineering. Degree minimum is 127 credits; the published plan totals 127-130 credits depending on the chosen branches. This file encodes the 127-credit branch exactly as printed: MATH 220 (2 cr, Semester 3), Natural Science GN elective (2 cr, Semester 4), and the 3-credit Semester 4 General Education option. Branch alternatives printed on the Bulletin: MATH 220 (2 cr) vs MATH 230E is not printed here; Natural Science GN elective 2 or 3 credits; Semester 4 General Education 3 or 4 credits. Prerequisites below are transcribed from the official Penn State Bulletin course descriptions (undergraduate bulletins.psu.edu course pages) on 2026-09-30. External placement/transfer prerequisites (MATH 022/040/041/026/081/082, PHYS 211T, CHEM 110, MATH 151/152, MATH 311W, STAT 414/415/416/417/418/440/460/480, MATH 451/455/456/457) are listed in external_prereqs. CMPSC 131 prerequisite verified on the Bulletin course page: 'CMPSC 121 or CMPSC 131 or department approval; prior knowledge of programming expected'. CMPSC 132 prerequisite verified on the Bulletin course page: 'CMPSC 121 and CMPSC 122, or CMPSC 131 and CMPSC 132, or CMPSC 121 and CMPSC 132; MATH 140 recommended'. CMPSC 121 prerequisite verified: 'MATH 21 or satisfactory performance on the mathematics placement examination or MATH 22 and MATH 26 concurrent' (encoded via MATH 022/026 external codes). CMPSC 122 prerequisite verified: 'CMPSC 121 or CMPSC 131 or CMPSC 201 or IST 256'. PHYS 212 prerequisite verified: 'MATH 141, PHYS 211'. MATH 141 prerequisite verified: 'MATH 140 or MATH 140B or MATH 140E or MATH 140G or MATH 140H'. MATH 230 prerequisite verified: 'MATH 141'. MATH 220 prerequisite verified: 'MATH 110 or MATH 140 or MATH 141 or MATH 140B or MATH 141B or satisfactory performance on the mathematics placement exam or equivalent AP credit'. CMPSC 221 prerequisite verified: 'CMPSC 122 or CMPSC 132'. CMPSC 222 prerequisite verified: 'CMPSC 122 or CMPSC 132'. CMPSC 360 prerequisite verified: 'MATH 141 or MATH 141B or MATH 140H'. CMPEN 270 prerequisite verified: 'CMPEN 271 or CMPEN 270T' (encoded as external prereq alternatives CMPEN 271). CMPSC 315 prerequisite verified: 'CMPSC 221 or CMPSC 224; CMPSC 360 concurrent'. CMPSC 320 prerequisite verified: 'CMPSC 221 or CMPSC 224'. CMPSC 465 prerequisite verified: 'CMPSC 360 and (CMPSC 221 or CMPSC 222 or CMPSC 224)'. STAT 318 prerequisite verified: 'MATH 141 or MATH 141B or MATH 140H or MATH 141H'. CMPSC 316 prerequisite verified: 'CMPSC 315'. CMPSC 461 prerequisite verified: 'CMPSC 360 and CMPSC 221 or CMPSC 224'. STAT 319 prerequisite verified: 'STAT 318 or (STAT 414 or STAT 415 or STAT 416 or STAT 417 or STAT 418 or STAT 440 or STAT 460 or STAT 480 or MATH 451 or MATH 455 or MATH 456 or MATH 457)'. ENGL 202C prerequisite verified: 'ENGL 15 or ENGL 30'. CMPSC 483W prerequisite verified: 'CMPSC 320 and CMPSC 461'. Note: CMPSC 131/132 are the newer sequence; the Bulletin lists 'CMPSC 121 or CMPSC 131' and 'CMPSC 122 or CMPSC 132' as alternates in the plan.
